voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In December 1872, a ship was found adrift in the Atlantic, between the Azores and Portugal.
The Mary Celeste was in good order. Her cargo was untouched. There was food on the table.
The captain, his wife, their daughter, and seven crew were all gone. A single lifeboat was missing.
beats.cap:
TEN PEOPLE GONE
ONE LIFEBOAT MISSING

beats.vo: No sign of storm. No sign of violence. No sign of anyone.
What happened on that ship has never been determined.
